categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Has the Validation label and modifies FlushStateToDisk() in src/validation.cpp to ensure block-file flush errors halt disk commits.
categories.rationale: Prevents chainstate metadata and coins cache corruption when block file disk flushes fail. Previously, FlushStateToDisk() ignored FlushChainstateBlockFile() errors and advanced m_last_flushed_block despite failed flushes, risking state divergence if fsync fails (for instance on a separate -blocksdir).
